<dc:description><div><p>I have a curse.</p><p>I have a gift.</p><p>I'm a monster. </p><p>I'm more than human.</p><p>My touch is lethal.</p><p>My touch is power.</p><p>I am their weapon.</p><p>I will fight back.</p><p>No one knows why Juliette's touch is fatal, but The Reestablishment has plans for her. Plans to use her as a weapon. But Juliette has plans of her own. After a lifetime without freedom, she's finally discovering a strength to fight back for the very first time—and to find a future with the one boy she thought she'd lost forever.</p></div></dc:description>
